title: On Grokking and the Dynamics of Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.33825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We extend the signal-channel theory of grokking introduced by Litman and Guo by relating training dissipation and evaluation transfer to population risk. For preconditioned gradient flows with time-dependent kernels, we distinguish two sources of limited evaluation visibility, namely small cumulative dissipation and weak transfer. We obtain quantitative bounds for task visibility and establish their stability under signal filtering and changes of evaluation distribution. We describe how task directions enter the effective signal channel through spectral activation or transport. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for the transferred signal to decrease squared population risk and derive classification error bounds under margin assumptions. translated_title: 论Grokking（顿悟）现象与泛化的动力学
translated_abstract: 我们扩展了Litman和Guo提出的grokking信号通道理论，将训练耗散与评估迁移同总体风险联系起来。对于具有时变核的预条件梯度流，我们区分了评估可见性受限的两种来源，即累积耗散过小与迁移能力薄弱。我们得到了任务可见性的定量界，并证明了其在信号过滤和评估分布变化下的稳定性。我们描述了任务方向如何通过谱激活或传输进入有效信号通道。我们建立了迁移信号能够降低平方总体风险的充要条件，并在间隔假设下推导出分类误差界。这些结果给出了同一训练轨迹在一种评估分布下能够泛化而在另一种评估分布下失败的充分条件。我们证明了谱上的（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文扩展了grokking的信号通道理论，通过将训练耗散与评估迁移同总体风险联系起来，导出了任务可见性的定量界、迁移信号降低总体风险的充要条件，以及同一训练轨迹在不同评估分布下泛化成败的充分条件。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the signal-channel theory of grokking by linking training dissipation and evaluation transfer to population risk, deriving quantitative bounds on task visibility, necessary and sufficient conditions for transferred signal to reduce population risk, and sufficient conditions for a single training trajectory to generalize under one evaluation distribution while failing under another.
